title: TS-40c Delete the Python infra after the drained check
description: Part of the flip (chatticus-6f27c5). After TS-40b is verified in development: delete the Python FrontDoor, ComputerWorker, ComputerlessWorker, TurnDeadline, the scheduler group, the Lambda Web Adapter layer, the SseSpike stack and the old TurnJobs and ComputerTurnJobs queues (only after preflight verifies them drained), and the ChatticusThinTurn* stacks, making sure no cross-stack export is left dangling (remove importers first; deploy order matters). Keep stack ids consistent with infra/lib/environments.ts and tagging.

comments.author: home
comments.text: From TS-40a: ControlPlane still imports the Messaging table (name and ARN) from ChatticusThinTurn via a cross-stack reference (ThinTurn publishes no SSM parameter for it). Move the table to the ControlPlane or a retained stack, and publish its name and ARN, BEFORE deleting ThinTurn; the Messaging table must be RETAINED (it holds the data). Also ThinTurn still owns the invoke and operator secrets: retain them (RemovalPolicy RETAIN) or move ownership first.

right_now_summary: The Messaging table and invoke and operator secrets must move or be retained before deleting ThinTurn.
